title: 技術問題
description: 排除技術問題的溝通用語

sentences.en: The error message that keeps appearing on my screen every time I try to open the application says the file is corrupted.
sentences.zh: 每次我嘗試開啟應用程式時螢幕上一直出現的錯誤訊息說檔案已損壞。

sentences.en: After restarting the router and waiting for two minutes, the internet connection was restored and everything worked normally again.
sentences.zh: 重新啟動路由器並等待兩分鐘後，網路連線恢復了，一切又正常運作了。

sentences.en: The technician who examined my laptop suggested that the overheating issue was caused by dust accumulating inside the cooling vents.
sentences.zh: 檢查我筆電的技術人員建議過熱問題是由散熱口內部積塵造成的。

sentences.en: To diagnose why the printer is not responding, first check whether it is properly connected and the drivers are up to date.
sentences.zh: 要診斷印表機為何沒有回應，首先檢查它是否正確連接以及驅動程式是否為最新版本。

sentences.en: The blue screen of death, which appeared suddenly during a video call, indicated a critical system failure requiring immediate attention.
sentences.zh: 在視訊通話期間突然出現的藍色當機畫面，表示一個需要立即處理的嚴重系統故障。

sentences.en: If the application keeps crashing after you updated it, try clearing the cache or reinstalling the software from scratch.
sentences.zh: 如果應用程式在你更新後一直當掉，試著清除快取或從頭重新安裝軟體。

sentences.en: The Wi-Fi signal in my bedroom, which is the farthest room from the router, is too weak to stream videos without buffering.
sentences.zh: 我臥室的Wi-Fi訊號——離路由器最遠的房間——太弱了，無法不中斷地串流影片。

sentences.en: Having spent three hours troubleshooting the network issue, I finally discovered that the ethernet cable was damaged near the connector.
sentences.zh: 花了三小時排除網路問題之後，我終於發現乙太網路線在接頭附近有損壞。

sentences.en: The software conflict between the newly installed antivirus and the existing firewall caused both programs to malfunction repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 新安裝的防毒軟體和現有防火牆之間的軟體衝突，導致兩個程式反覆故障。

sentences.en: Before contacting technical support, make sure you have your product serial number, purchase date, and a description of the problem ready.
sentences.zh: 在聯繫技術支援之前，請確保你準備好產品序號、購買日期和問題描述。

sentences.en: The hard drive that was making clicking noises for several days finally failed, resulting in the complete loss of all stored data.
sentences.zh: 發出喀喀聲好幾天的硬碟終於壞了，導致所有儲存的資料完全遺失。

sentences.en: Running the built-in system diagnostics tool can help identify hardware issues that might not be obvious from external observation.
sentences.zh: 執行內建的系統診斷工具可以幫助找出從外部觀察可能不明顯的硬體問題。

sentences.en: The computer keeps shutting down randomly, which suggests that either the power supply is failing or the processor is overheating.
sentences.zh: 電腦一直隨機關機，這暗示不是電源供應器出問題就是處理器過熱。

sentences.en: After updating the graphics driver to the latest version, the screen flickering problem that had persisted for weeks was finally resolved.
sentences.zh: 將顯示卡驅動程式更新到最新版本後，持續了好幾週的螢幕閃爍問題終於解決了。

sentences.en: The customer service representative asked me to describe the issue in detail so that they could escalate it to the appropriate department.
sentences.zh: 客服代表要求我詳細描述問題，以便他們將其轉交給適當的部門。

sentences.en: Resetting the device to its factory settings, which erases all personal data, should only be used as a last resort for persistent problems.
sentences.zh: 將裝置重設為原廠設定會清除所有個人資料，應該只在持續性問題的最後手段時使用。

sentences.en: The software update that was supposed to fix the login bug actually introduced three new issues that affected thousands of users.
sentences.zh: 原本應該修復登入錯誤的軟體更新，實際上引入了三個影響數千名使用者的新問題。

sentences.en: If your device is not recognized when plugged into the USB port, try using a different cable or connecting it to another port.
sentences.zh: 如果你的裝置插入USB連接埠時沒有被識別，試著使用不同的線材或連接到另一個連接埠。

sentences.en: The intermittent connectivity issue, which only occurs during peak hours, is likely caused by network congestion in our area.
sentences.zh: 只在尖峰時段發生的間歇性連線問題，很可能是我們地區的網路壅塞造成的。

sentences.en: Checking the system event logs can provide valuable clues about what went wrong before the unexpected crash occurred yesterday.
sentences.zh: 檢查系統事件日誌可以提供有價值的線索，了解昨天意外當機之前發生了什麼問題。

sentences.en: The repair shop estimated that replacing the cracked screen on my tablet would cost nearly as much as buying a new device.
sentences.zh: 維修店估計更換我平板裂開的螢幕，費用幾乎和買一台新裝置一樣多。

sentences.en: After disabling all browser extensions one by one, I identified the problematic add-on that was causing web pages to load slowly.
sentences.zh: 逐一停用所有瀏覽器擴充功能後，我找出了導致網頁載入緩慢的問題附加元件。

sentences.en: The warranty period for this product expired last month, which means any repairs from this point forward will require out-of-pocket payment.
sentences.zh: 這個產品的保固期上個月已到期，意味著從現在起任何維修都需要自費。

sentences.en: Incompatible software versions running on different team members' computers caused the shared project files to become corrupted.
sentences.zh: 不同團隊成員電腦上運行的不相容軟體版本，導致共用的專案檔案損壞了。

sentences.en: The troubleshooting guide recommended checking the power cable, reseating the memory modules, and running a disk integrity scan.
sentences.zh: 故障排除指南建議檢查電源線、重新安裝記憶體模組，並執行磁碟完整性掃描。

sentences.en: Despite following every step in the manual carefully, the device refused to connect to the wireless network for unknown reasons.
sentences.zh: 儘管仔細遵循手冊中的每個步驟，裝置因不明原因拒絕連接到無線網路。

sentences.en: The automated system recovery tool, which runs during startup when it detects an issue, restored my computer to a working state.
sentences.zh: 在偵測到問題時於啟動期間運行的自動系統復原工具，將我的電腦恢復到可運作的狀態。

sentences.en: If none of the basic troubleshooting steps resolve the issue, you may need to schedule an appointment with an authorized service center.
sentences.zh: 如果所有基本的故障排除步驟都無法解決問題，你可能需要預約授權服務中心。

sentences.en: The corrupted system file that prevented Windows from booting properly was repaired using the recovery environment and command-line tools.
sentences.zh: 阻止Windows正常啟動的損壞系統檔案，使用修復環境和命令列工具修復了。

sentences.en: Documenting the exact steps that led to the error helps technical support reproduce the issue and find a solution more quickly.
sentences.zh: 記錄導致錯誤的確切步驟，幫助技術支援重現問題並更快找到解決方案。
